## What this portfolio demonstrates

- Applied GIS and spatial data science in real operational settings
- Reproducible notebooks and transparent analytical workflows
- Public-health communication through maps, dashboards, and plain-language summaries
- Enterprise GIS, field apps, UAS/drone data, remote sensing, and vector-control analytics

## Current focus

I am especially interested in geospatial decision-support systems that connect field data, surveillance, environmental conditions, and treatment operations into reproducible and explainable workflows.
